name: Cebu Masters 2018

venue.name: [Talamban Times Square](http://www.knowcebu.com/talamban-times-square/)
venue.address: Gov. M. Cuenco Ave, Cebu City, Cebu

information: Registration fee (Inclusion: Certificate of Participation and a Qiyi Warrior W 3x3x3) starts at P250.00 for the first 3 events and P50.00 additional per event OR P 100.00 additional good for 3 events, this is up to June 6, 2018 only for the early bird registration. Regular based registration of P 300.00 for 3 events and P 50.00 additional per event will apply starting June 7, 2018. Payment-first system shall be implemented before WCA registrations can be approved and included on the official list of registered participants. Registration closes on June 30, 2018 so please pre-register and settle your payments on or before that date. Requests for change of events are only allowed up to the registration cut-off. Strictly no refund and no walk-in registrations on the day of the event. FIRST PAY, FIRST SERVE basis due to limited slots allowed.
